summary: One documentation behavior: close the ST-01 creative pass by writing design_private/encounter_beats.md and design_private/spoiler_map.md (reveal/lore beat assignment, 3-5 motifs, MacGuffin per section 23, >=2 endings per section 24, secret-fact map), then run the named final spoiler audit for AC-cp-spoiler over design_private/, gitignore state, and the story's commit messages. Scope holds: one named changed subsystem, two files, no code; the audit is verification/evidence of the same pass behavior, not an independent feature, and it fixes no defects (roster mapping problems must be recorded as defects, not silently rewritten). Dependencies on WI-01a/WI-01b are correct and acyclic; both exist and are its direct siblings. Criteria AC-cp-mapping and AC-cp-spoiler are preserved verbatim from ST-01; with siblings' AC-cp-world and AC-cp-roster the union covers every parent criterion and AC-cp-spoiler has one named final proof owner. Verification is focused on reading the two files plus the audit, and the handoff names the exact request sections (3, 11.4, 23, 24, 37, 51, 66, 67, 74) and prerequisite outputs, so a fresh implementer can proceed without reconstructing the project. The section 72 cut candidate is recorded as an assumption, not a scope drop.
